description: Two server replicas sharing one Postgres store: a request created on instance A appears in instance B's ListRequests listing without any local write on B having mirrored it. This exercises the ListRequests store read-through end to end, the process-level counterpart to the Go-side TestListRequestsSeesOtherReplicaCreates proof. Requires TOOLPLANE_CONFORMANCE_MULTI_INSTANCE=1 plus TOOLPLANE_DATABASE_URL so the conformance bootstrap boots a second server replica.

request.name: conformance-multi-instance-list-session
request.description: session for multi-instance list visibility fixture
